hooks.command: command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip3 install -q graphifyy >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip3 install -q --user graphifyy >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1; true
hooks.statusMessage: Preparando graphify (instalação e atualização incremental do grafo)...

hooks.command: F=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$F" in *.py|*.js|*.ts|*.tsx|*.jsx|*.go|*.rs|*.java|*.rb|*.c|*.h|*.cpp|*.cs|*.php|*.sh|*.kt|*.swift|*.vue|*.svelte) command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
